new: This raises an objection: if the mantras have no meaning, explaining their meaning is a senseless thing. Yaska answers that the objects are there before us; a blind man not seeing them is no reason to say the objects do not exist, and such talk is the talk of the ignorant.
basis: Kannada p.30: vedamantragalige artha illada mele arthavivaraNe buddhiyillada maatu emba aakshepane; padaarthagalu eduriginiruvudu, kurudanige kaanisadiddamaatrakke illa emba maatu ajnara maatu
